          About PokéRoulette

          Tap the centre Poké Ball or swipe the wheel to spin. Search by name or Pokédex number, explore evolutions, toggle shiny artwork, and tap cards to preview or share.

          COLLECTION & SETS

          Collect Pokémon and cards in Dex. Collect cards variants in Sets. Add All uses Standard or the base Holo; Remove All clears the set. Tap the magnifying glass to search sets or cards. Retracting search keeps the filter; clear the text to reset.

          Progress counts cards, not every variant. Your collection is saved locally; sign in through Profile to sync across devices.

          CARDS & SOURCES

          Green counts: loaded, including saved lists.
          Yellow counts: partial or loading. Use Refresh Cards / Sets to retry.

          Data: PokéAPI, Pokémon TCG API and TCGdex, with supplementary artwork and references. GBP values are approximate market estimates; Market N/A means unavailable.
